t: Car Parts: OEM vs Aftermarket | Parts Matter™
s: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) parts are made by the vehicle's manufacturer, whereas aftermarket parts are often produced by a different company than the vehicle manufacturer. At first glance, it sounds very simple, but it gets more complicated on further inspection. The manufacturers that make vehicles today very often don't make many of the parts they use to assemble their vehicles. Car makers buy many parts from a large network of vehicle component manufacturers who design and make car parts to meet the specifications of the car companies.
